What's it called when you make a typo when you're writing with a pen?
When is a typo not a typo?

It doesn't happen the same with a pen as a keyboard. There's a lot more complex motion going on. On a keyboard it's a very simple motion. More likely to be a mistake in spelling than a mistaken character written down.

My favorite is when I write the next word I'm thinking instead of the word I needed to write. Or if a customer is asking me questions while I'm writing I end up writing something they said. I space out at work a lot.
Or when the next word begins with a letter and you can't stop writing that letter suddenly.
I've never had written stuttering before. Sounds awful!

You can't make a typo when writing with a pen.

A typo is short for a typographical mistake, which means a mistake that is specific to a typewriter or equivalent (computer hardware keyboard, smartphone virtual keyboard, etc.) that manifests as pressing or tapping the wrong key even though you knew the correct key to press or tap.

What you make when you write with a pen is a spelling mistake. You didn't know how the word was spelled.
